decision: Matrix instead of Signal-Server
why: Signal-Server unhostable past registration (SGX contact discovery, undocumented storage-service/SVR2/zkgroup)
evidence: softwaremill.com/can-you-self-host-the-signal-server (Apr 2025); jtof-dev/Signal-Docker roadmap

decision: Synapse+Postgres over Tuwunel for v1
why: appservice/bot APIs and docs most mature; Tuwunel documented as the lighter swap in RUNBOOK
evidence: matrix.org deployments; Tuwunel single-node only

decision: Rumi integration = additive channel driver inside rumi-platform, not a separate bridge
why: rumi-platform already has slack/discord additive drivers with parity tests; a bridge would duplicate 500 call sites of routing
evidence: bot/shared/services/messaging/channel-registry.js, discord-*.js

decision: Rumi placement via Element welcome_user_id + auto_join_rooms
why: built-in Element feature: new users get a DM with that user; no client fork needed
evidence: element-web docs/config.md welcome_user_id

decision: Full Rumi brain reply not verifiable locally
why: no OPENROUTER/SUPABASE keys on this machine; rumi-platform .env absent
evidence: ls rumi-platform/.env -> only .env.template
result: channel verified with live Synapse + mocked dispatch; keys wizard for Kamal

decision: Synapse image has no JSON log formatter (no python-json-logger, no synapse.logging.formatter.JsonFormatter); dropped in a stdlib-only /data/rumi_log_format.py + PYTHONPATH=/data on the synapse service
why: docker logs must be structured JSON per the brief; image ships neither dependency
evidence: docker compose run --entrypoint python3 synapse -c import pythonjsonlogger -> ModuleNotFoundError; docker logs rumi-synapse now shows {"timestamp":...,"level":...} lines

decision: Used the shared-secret HMAC v2 admin register endpoint (/_synapse/admin/v1/register) directly via curl in e2e.sh instead of register_new_matrix_user/docker compose exec
why: e2e.sh brief requires bash+curl+python3 only, no docker compose dependency for the check script itself
evidence: curl round-trip against /_synapse/admin/v1/register nonce+hmac succeeded for e2e-<epoch>-a/b

decision: register_new_matrix_user needs --no-admin (not a blank flag) or it blocks on an interactive Make-admin prompt; added --exists-ok everywhere for idempotent user creation
why: first setup.sh run hung/errored on EOFError from the interactive prompt when creating the rumi bot user
evidence: setup.sh log: 'ERROR creating user rumi: ... EOFError when reading a line' before the fix, clean 'created user rumi' after

decision: Verified full stack end to end: setup.sh twice (idempotent, no re-generate/re-create on 2nd run) + e2e.sh twice (8/8 pass both times), stack left running on rumi- containers at 127.0.0.1:8108/8182, separate from the pre-existing matrix-synapse/matrix-element demo on 8008/8082
why: mandatory verification step in the brief
evidence: docker ps shows rumi-postgres/rumi-synapse/rumi-element healthy; /tmp/setup2.log, /tmp/setup_idempotent.log; e2e.sh output '8 passed, 0 failed' both runs

decision: welcome_user_id is dead code in current Element (verified: matrix-react-sdk PR #12153 "Remove welcome bot welcome_user_id support" merged upstream), so it does NOT auto-open a DM with @rumi despite being documented (marked DEPRECATED, not "removed") in config.md
why: Registered a fresh throwaway user against live Synapse with welcome_user_id set and the @rumi account pre-existing; no DM was created, no related client log lines fired; grepped a shallow clone of element-hq/element-web develop and found the feature's removal commit referenced only in CHANGELOG.md, zero remaining references in apps/web source
evidence: kept welcome_user_id in config.template.json anyway (harmless, forward-compatible, matches the brief's literal ask) but added embedded_pages.home_url pointing at welcome.html as the real compensating mechanism

decision: Reused welcome.html for both embedded_pages.welcome_url and embedded_pages.home_url
why: HomePage.tsx renders EmbeddedPage with the identical sanitizer/className contract as the logged-out welcome screen whenever a logged-in user has no rooms (exactly the state a brand-new account is in) -- this is the only config-only way left to put a "Talk to Rumi" CTA in front of every new user post-registration now that welcome_user_id is inert
evidence: verified with Playwright: registered rumitest<ts>, landed on #/home with no rooms, "Talk to Rumi" CTA visible, click created a real DM room (!NIqtrr...:localhost), invited @rumi, sent + received message rendered
result: accepted; known compromise: Sign in/Create account links stay visible on the home variant even though the visitor is already logged in (harmless, minor UX noise, not a functional bug)

decision: welcome.html rewritten with zero <style>/<script>/class/id -- only h1/p/div/a/img tags and img/span[style] attributes
why: EmbeddedPage.tsx's shared sanitizer (packages/shared-utils/src/html/sanitizeHtmlParams.ts) has a fixed MATRIX_FORMATTING_TAGS allowlist that excludes <style>, <script>, <section>, and a fixed MATRIX_ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES map that allows "style" only on font/span/img and "class" nowhere -- a first draft using a scoped <style> block + classes + a JS href-patcher rendered with zero CSS applied and the mark full native 1080px size
evidence: confirmed via page.evaluate: 0 elements matched injected classes, <style> tag and its text content were discarded entirely (disallowedTagsMode: discard), <script> never ran
result: rebuilt using only allowed tags; "buttons" are <a href> wrapping a styled <span> (anchor itself cannot carry style, but its clickable box equals the span's styled box)

decision: Talk to Rumi href keeps a literal __SERVER_NAME__ placeholder inside welcome.html, unresolved by any script in this deliverable
why: welcome.html is mounted read-only by docker-compose (owned by the parallel deploy agent) with no templating step of its own -- only config.template.json is documented as setup-script-rendered -- and the sanitizer strips <script> and id attributes so no client-side JS workaround is possible either
evidence: flagged as a cross-repo follow-up: scripts/setup.sh (or docker-compose) should sed-replace __SERVER_NAME__ in deploy/element/welcome.html the same way it already does for config.template.json before mounting; verified locally only by rendering a throwaway copy for the preview container, the committed file still ships with the placeholder

decision: Generated rumi-mark-navy-tight.png (699x294, bbox-cropped from rumi-mark-navy-transparent.png) as a new asset for the welcome/home page logo
why: rumi-mark-navy-transparent.png is a heavily-padded 1080x1080 square (real mark only ~258px tall inside it) -- sizing it to a legible small header height (e.g. height:40px) shrinks the actual visible mark to ~10px, unreadable; no navy tight-crop equivalent of rumi-mark-white-smile.png existed in assets/
evidence: PIL getbbox() on the source asset gave (208,399,871,657); cropped with 18px padding, verified visually in the rendered welcome screenshot at height:44px -- dots and smile both legible, aspect ratio ~2.38:1 preserved (single dimension set, per brand rule)
result: accepted, new derived asset added under deploy/element/assets/, no existing asset recoloured/distorted

decision: Left "compound" Compound-design-system token overrides out of config.template.json
why: theming.md's only documented compound keys are two example tokens (--cpd-color-icon-accent-tertiary, --cpd-color-text-action-accent) remapped to existing blue palette vars -- there is no documented list of the actual primary-action-button tokens, and the brief requires every config key used to exist in the fetched docs
evidence: verified in the live preview that core chat buttons (Register, Send) render in Element's default black/compound styling rather than coral, while roomlist/timeline/avatar colors from setting_defaults.custom_themes do apply
result: documented as a known gap rather than guessing undocumented --cpd-* variable names; a follow-up pass reading compound.element.io's semantic-token docs could close it

decision: Rumi placement moved server-side: bot greets every new member of #rumi-announcements with a DM; Element home_url welcome page keeps a Talk to Rumi button as the client-side path
why: Element Web removed welcome_user_id (element-web PR #12153); a fresh registration produced no auto-DM
evidence: app builder Playwright run against Element on :8282; element-web CHANGELOG
result: accepted; added to matrix channel adapter scope

decision: chmod 600 deploy/.env, deploy/rumi-channel.env, and (via rootful docker compose run --entrypoint sh synapse) homeserver.yaml + signing key inside the container-owned data dir
why: reviewer found all three world-readable (664/644); homeserver.yaml holds registration_shared_secret, macaroon_secret_key, form_secret
evidence: ls -la after fix: -rw------- on all three; verified on both /tmp/rumi-verify2 scratch run and the live 8108/8182 stack

decision: setup.sh now captures any pre-exported SERVER_NAME/PUBLIC_BASE_URL/SYNAPSE_PORT/ELEMENT_PORT/BIND_ADDR/REGISTRATION_MODE/COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME/RUMI_CONTAINER_PREFIX before touching .env, bakes them into a freshly-created .env, and re-exports them after sourcing so they always win over the file
why: reviewer reproduced SYNAPSE_PORT=8208 ./scripts/setup.sh still binding 8008 on a clean checkout
evidence: fresh /tmp/rumi-verify2 run with SYNAPSE_PORT=8208 ELEMENT_PORT=8283 exported bound 127.0.0.1:8208/8283 (ss -ltnp), not 8008/8082

decision: docker-compose.yml name: is now ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-rumi-messenger}; discovered mid-fix that Docker Compose resolves that default into COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME for the whole file's interpolation context, so container_name could not reuse the same variable/default (it collapsed rumi-postgres into rumi-messenger-postgres) -- added a separate RUMI_CONTAINER_PREFIX var (default rumi) for container_name instead, documented in .env.example
why: reviewer flagged hardcoded project name causing volume sharing across checkouts; verification run needed BOTH a distinct project AND distinct container names to coexist with the live 8108 stack without conflict
evidence: docker compose config with no overrides still resolves to rumi-postgres/rumi-synapse/rumi-element; with COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=verify2 RUMI_CONTAINER_PREFIX=verify2 exported, containers came up as verify2-postgres/verify2-synapse/verify2-element alongside the untouched live rumi-* stack

decision: pinned postgres:16-alpine -> postgres:16.15-alpine, matrixdotorg/synapse:latest -> :v1.161.0, vectorim/element-web:latest -> :v1.12.28 (versions resolved from the already-pulled :latest images via docker image inspect labels), each with a one-line upgrade comment
why: reviewer flagged unpinned :latest tags as non-reproducible
evidence: docker pull succeeded for all three exact tags; docker ps on the live stack after rerunning setup.sh shows matrixdotorg/synapse:v1.161.0, vectorim/element-web:v1.12.28, postgres:16.15-alpine, all healthy

decision: added healthcheck to synapse (curl -fsS http://localhost:8008/health) and element (wget -q http://localhost:80/), and changed element's depends_on to condition: service_healthy on synapse
why: reviewer required health-gated startup ordering instead of depends_on's default (only waits for container start, not readiness)
evidence: docker compose up -d element blocked until synapse reported healthy in both the verify2 scratch run and the live rerun; docker ps shows (healthy) on both services

decision: e2e.sh rewritten around json_field/json_list_contains/json_chunk_has_body helpers that always try/except JSON parsing and print empty/0 instead of raising; every check now reports one clean FAIL line with a reason instead of a bare Python traceback when Synapse is down
why: reviewer reproduced raw tracebacks when Synapse was unreachable
evidence: docker compose stop synapse then scripts/e2e.sh printed 5 clean FAIL lines (0 tracebacks) and exited 1; docker compose start synapse + rerun returned to 9/9 pass

decision: renamed deploy/element/welcome.html source to welcome.template.html; setup.sh now renders it (same __SERVER_NAME__/__PUBLIC_BASE_URL__ substitution as config.template.json) to welcome.html, which is gitignored; e2e.sh gained a check that the served /welcome.html contains @rumi:<SERVER_NAME> and no literal __SERVER_NAME__
why: the branding agent's welcome.html had a literal __SERVER_NAME__ in its Talk-to-Rumi deep link; Element's HTML sanitizer strips any client-side templating so the placeholder would reach real users verbatim
evidence: curl .../welcome.html on the live stack contains @rumi:localhost and no __SERVER_NAME__; e2e.sh check passes on both the live stack and the verify2 scratch run

decision: full round-2 re-verification: fresh /tmp/rumi-verify2 scratch copy on 8208/8283 with COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=verify2/RUMI_CONTAINER_PREFIX=verify2 (setup twice for idempotency, e2e 9/9 both times, failure-injection via docker compose stop synapse -> 5 clean FAILs + exit 1, recovery back to 9/9), then torn down with down -v; live 8108/8182 stack rerun with the same setup.sh so it picked up the permission/image/healthcheck fixes, left running, e2e 9/9
why: mandatory re-verification per the reviewer's round-2 requirements
evidence: /tmp/verify2_setup1.log, /tmp/verify2_setup2.log, /tmp/live_setup_fixed.log; docker ps shows rumi-postgres/rumi-synapse/rumi-element healthy on pinned images with 600-mode secret files
